exposure: Hospital policy on breastfeeding and formula milk
Antenatal education of pregnant women using breastfeeding videos
Immediate skin-to-skin contact after caesarean birth
Monthly antenatal classes for women identified as high risk for breastfeeding challenges
cohort: The study involved the population of pregnant women and new mothers at a private hospital in Tanzania.
finding: Implementation of a multidimensional quality improvement project using the PDSA framework significantly improved early breastfeeding initiation rates (from 22% to 84%) and exclusive breastfeeding rates (from 45% to 90%) at the hospital.
mod_finding: Immediate skin-to-skin contact after caesarean birth was one of the implemented strategies to improve breastfeeding practices.
